intro: We’re UTEP’s IEEE Robotics & Automation Society student organization. We bring students together to build robots, compete, and learn from one another.
welcome: All majors and experience levels are welcome. We’re a close-knit group: we work on projects, travel to competitions, and spend time together outside the workshop.

sections.title: Competition teams
sections.copy: Competition teams are our main focus, bringing mechanical, electrical, and software work together. Join a general meeting or a competition team meeting to meet the group, learn more, and get involved.

sections.title: Beyond competitions
sections.copy: We also work on fun projects, run occasional workshops, and organize social events and hangouts. We work closely with IEEE, which focuses on helping students build professional skills.

sections.title: Our chapter
sections.copy: IEEE RAS has a history at UTEP. After a period of inactivity, students revived the chapter over the past few years. Since the restart, we’ve competed at the IEEE Region 5 Robotics Competition, finishing 7th out of 30 teams.

sections.title: Partners & sponsors
sections.copy: We’re looking for partners and sponsors to support our teams. Opportunities for recognition include our website and competition vehicles.
